Select Max(A.SALESORDERDATE) LastOrderDate,
       Trunc(Sysdate) - Max(A.SALESORDERDATE) || ' Days Ago' As DaysAgo,
       'Last Order' as Title,
       '' as SubTitle
From  D_CUSTOMER_360VIEW_PENDINGORDERS a, PARTY B
Where B.PARTYCODE = a.vendorcode(+)
  AND B.PARTYCode = :P511_CUSTOMERCODE
Group by B.PARTYCode

Select
      B.PartyCode,
      Case When nvl(count(a.TNo),0) = 0 then '-'
           else to_Char(nvl(count(a.TNo),0))
      end as PendingSO,
      case when nvl(round(sum(a.quantity1),3),0) = 0 and nvl(round(sum(a.quantity2),3),0) = 0 then '-'
           when nvl(round(sum(a.quantity1),3),0) != 0 and nvl(round(sum(a.quantity2),3),0) != 0 then
            'P Quantity : '||to_char(sum(a.quantity1)) ||' S Quantity '||to_char(sum(a.quantity2))
           when nvl(round(sum(a.quantity1),3),0) != 0 and nvl(round(sum(a.quantity2),3),0) = 0 then
            'P Quantity : '||to_char(sum(a.quantity1))
      end as Quantity,
      Case when nvl(round(sum(a.TotalAmount),2),0) = 0 then '-'
           else to_Char(nvl(round(sum(a.TotalAmount),2),0))
      end as Amount
From  D_CUSTOMER_360VIEW_PENDINGORDERS a, PARTY B
Where B.PARTYCODE = a.vendorcode(+)
  AND B.PARTYCode = :P511_CUSTOMERCODE
Group by B.PARTYCode

With Sd As (
       Select PartyCode From Party

        Connect By Prior PartyCode = ParentCode),
     Asof As (Select to_date(:P908_TODATE,'DD-MM-RRRR') D From dual),
     Alc As (
       Select a.DrVoucherTno Tno, a.DrVoucherSno Sno, -Sum(a.Amount) Amt
         From DrCrAllocation a, Voucher dv, Voucher cv, Asof
        Where dv.Tno = a.DrVoucherTno And cv.Tno = a.CrVoucherTno
          And dv.VoucherDate <= Asof.D And cv.VoucherDate <= Asof.D
        Group By a.DrVoucherTno, a.DrVoucherSno
       Union All
       Select a.CrVoucherTno, a.CrVoucherSno, Sum(a.Amount)
         From DrCrAllocation a, Voucher dv, Voucher cv, Asof
        Where dv.Tno = a.DrVoucherTno And cv.Tno = a.CrVoucherTno
          And dv.VoucherDate <= Asof.D And cv.VoucherDate <= Asof.D
        Group By a.CrVoucherTno, a.CrVoucherSno),
     Al As (Select Tno, Sno, Sum(Amt) Amt From Alc Group By Tno, Sno),
     Aged As (
       Select d.AccountCode Pty, d.CompanyCode Cmp, d.LocationCode Loc, cast(null as varchar2(100)) Pnl,
              -(d.Amount - nvl(al.Amt,0)) Recv,
              d.VoucherDate Vdt, v.VoucherNo Vno, v.DocTypeCode Dtc,
              ao.BillDate AoBillDate,
              coalesce(i.DueDate, sb.DueDate, ao.BillDueDate) DueDate,

              Case When nvl(:P908_AGEBASIS,'DUE') = 'DUE'
                        And coalesce(i.DueDate, sb.DueDate, ao.BillDueDate) Is Null Then 7
                   When nvl(:P908_AGEBASIS,'DUE') = 'DUE'
                        And coalesce(i.DueDate, sb.DueDate, ao.BillDueDate) >= Asof.D Then 0
                   When (Case When :P908_AGEBASIS = 'DOC'
                              Then Asof.D - coalesce(i.InvoiceDate, ao.BillDate, d.VoucherDate)
                              Else Greatest(Asof.D - coalesce(i.DueDate, sb.DueDate, ao.BillDueDate),0) End) <=  30 Then 1
                   When (Case When :P908_AGEBASIS = 'DOC'
                              Then Asof.D - coalesce(i.InvoiceDate, ao.BillDate, d.VoucherDate)
                              Else Greatest(Asof.D - coalesce(i.DueDate, sb.DueDate, ao.BillDueDate),0) End) <=  60 Then 2
                   When (Case When :P908_AGEBASIS = 'DOC'
                              Then Asof.D - coalesce(i.InvoiceDate, ao.BillDate, d.VoucherDate)
                              Else Greatest(Asof.D - coalesce(i.DueDate, sb.DueDate, ao.BillDueDate),0) End) <=  90 Then 3

                              Else Greatest(Asof.D - coalesce(i.DueDate, sb.DueDate, ao.BillDueDate),0) End) <= 180 Then 4

                              Else Greatest(Asof.D - coalesce(i.DueDate, sb.DueDate, ao.BillDueDate),0) End) <= 365 Then 5

/* A payment line is a DEBIT - its settlements sit on the Dr side of the bridge, the mirror of the receivables page. */ With Asof As (Select to_date(:P923_TODATE,'DD-MM-RRRR') D From dual), Alc As ( Select a.DrVoucherTno Tno, a.DrVoucherSno Sno, Sum(a.Amount) Amt, Count(*) N From DrCrAllocation a, Voucher dv, Voucher cv, Asof Where dv.Tno = a.DrVoucherTno And cv.Tno = a.CrVoucherTno And dv.VoucherDate <= Asof.D And cv.VoucherDate <= Asof.D Group By a.DrVoucherTno, a.DrVoucherSno) Select d.Tno As VOUCHER_TNO, v.VoucherNo As RECEIPT_NO, d.VoucherDate As RECEIPT_DATE, Round(-d.Amount,2) As RECEIPT_AMOUNT, Round(nvl(al.Amt,0),2) As APPLIED, Round(-d.Amount - nvl(al.Amt,0),2) As UNAPPLIED, nvl(al.N,0) As BILLS_SETTLED, Case When nvl(al.N,0) = 0 Then 'Unapplied' When -d.Amount - nvl(al.Amt,0) > 0.005 Then 'Partly applied' Else 'Fully applied' End As STATUS, v.MoneyTransferReferenceNo As BANK_REFERENCE, nvl(l.LocationName, d.LocationCode) As LOCATION, substr(d.Narration,1,300) As NARRATION From VoucherDetail d Join Voucher v On v.Tno = d.Tno Left Join Alc al On al.Tno = d.Tno And al.Sno = d.Sno Left Join Location l On l.LocationCode = d.LocationCode Where d.AccountCode = :P923_PARTY And v.DocTypeCode In ('PAYMENT','CASHPAYMENT','BANKPAYMENT') And d.Amount < 0 And d.VoucherDate >= to_date(:P923_FROMDATE,'DD-MM-RRRR') And d.VoucherDate < to_date(:P923_TODATE,'DD-MM-RRRR') + 1 And (cast(null as varchar2(100)) Is Null Or cast(null as varchar2(100)) = cast(null as varchar2(100))) And (null Is Null Or cast(null as varchar2(100)) = null) And (:P923_COMPANY Is Null Or d.CompanyCode = :P923_COMPANY) And (:P923_LOCATION Is Null Or d.LocationCode = :P923_LOCATION)

/* The bridge itself, one row per payment x bill. This is the only place in the dashboard where the many-to-many relationship is shown at its own grain - everywhere else it is pre-aggregated before joining, or the outstanding figure would duplicate. On the AP side the BILL is the credit line (cv) and the PAYMENT is the debit line (dv) - the exact mirror of the receivables page. */ With Asof As (Select to_date(:P923_TODATE,'DD-MM-RRRR') D From dual) Select cv.VoucherNo As BILL_VOUCHER, cv.Tno As BILL_TNO, coalesce(pb.PartyBillNo, ao.BillNo, cv.VoucherNo) As BILL_REFERENCE, cv.VoucherDate As BILL_DATE, dv.VoucherNo As RECEIPT_VOUCHER, dv.Tno As RECEIPT_TNO, dv.VoucherDate As RECEIPT_DATE, Round(a.Amount,2) As ALLOCATED, dv.VoucherDate - cv.VoucherDate As DAYS_TO_SETTLE, nvl(cl.LocationName, cd.LocationCode) As BILL_LOCATION, nvl(dl.LocationName, dd.LocationCode) As RECEIPT_LOCATION, Case When dd.LocationCode <> cd.LocationCode Then 'Cross-location' Else 'Same location' End As SETTLEMENT_TYPE From DrCrAllocation a Join Voucher dv On dv.Tno = a.DrVoucherTno Join Voucher cv On cv.Tno = a.CrVoucherTno Join VoucherDetail cd On cd.Tno = a.CrVoucherTno And cd.Sno = a.CrVoucherSno Left Join VoucherDetail dd On dd.Tno = a.DrVoucherTno And dd.Sno = a.DrVoucherSno Left Join PBPass pp On cv.ModuleCode = 'PBPASS' And pp.Tno = cv.ModuleTno Left Join PurchaseBill pb On pb.Tno = pp.PurchaseBillTno Left Join AccountOpening ao On cv.VoucherNo = 'OPENING' And ao.Tno = cd.ModuleTno Left Join Location dl On dl.LocationCode = dd.LocationCode Left Join Location cl On cl.LocationCode = cd.LocationCode Cross Join Asof Where cd.AccountCode = :P923_PARTY And dv.VoucherDate <= Asof.D And cv.VoucherDate <= Asof.D

Select d.SNo As LINE_NO, nvl((Select i.ItemName From Item i Where i.ItemCode = d.ItemCode), d.ItemCode) As ITEM, nvl((Select s.ItemSpecificationName From ItemSpecification s Where s.ItemSpecificationCode = d.ItemSpecificationCode), 'no specification') As SPECIFICATION, d.Quantity1 As QUANTITY, nvl((Select m.MeasuringUnitName From MeasuringUnit m Where m.MeasuringUnitCode = d.RateMeasuringUnitCode), 'no unit') As UOM, d.Rate As RATE, d.Amount As AMOUNT, d.TotalAmount As TOTAL_WITH_TAX, -- The rate actually realised on this line, which can differ from the -- stored Rate when the quantity or amount was adjusted after entry. Order Lines

What was ordered and how much of each line has arrived. Pending quantity is capped at the ordered quantity, so an over-receipt shows as complete rather than as a negative outstanding.

Select od.SNo As LINE_NO, nvl((Select i.ItemName From Item i Where i.ItemCode = od.ItemCode), od.ItemCode) As ITEM, nvl((Select s.ItemSpecificationName From ItemSpecification s Where s.ItemSpecificationCode = od.ItemSpecificationCode), 'no specification') As SPECIFICATION, od.Quantity1 As ORDERED, nvl(od.ReceivedQuantity1,0) As RECEIVED, -- GREATEST(...,0) so an over-receipt reads as nothing outstanding, never -- as a negative pending quantity. Greatest(od.Quantity1 - nvl(od.ReceivedQuantity1,0), 0) As PENDING, od.Rate As RATE, od.DiscountRate As DISCOUNT_RATE, od.Amount As AMOUNT, '' || Case When nvl(od.Quantity1,0) = 0 Then 'No quantity' When nvl(od.ReceivedQuantity1,0) >= od.Quantity1 Then 'Complete' When nvl(od.ReceivedQuantity1,0) > 0 Then 'Part received' Else 'Awaited' End || '' As STATUS From PurchaseOrderDetail od Join PCC_PurchaseOrder o On o.TNo = od.TNo Where o.TNo = :P939_TNO And ((Select SAGAR.GetUserPanelAB_apex() From dual) Is Null Or o.Panel = (Select SAGAR.GetUserPanelAB_apex() From dual)) Order By od.SNo

Documents Against This Order

The receipts and bills booked against this order. These are shown for traceability — they are not what drives the progress figures above, which come from the order line itself.

Select g.GrnNo As GRN_NO, g.GrnDate As GRN_DATE, GetLocationName(g.LocationCode) As LOCATION, Count(gd.SNo) As LINES, Sum(nvl(gd.ReceivedQuantity1,0)) As RECEIVED_QTY, Sum(nvl(gd.RejectedQuantity1,0)) As REJECTED_QTY, Case When Sum(nvl(gd.RejectedQuantity1,0)) > 0 Then 'Rejection recorded' Else 'Accepted' End As STATUS From PCC_Grn g Join GrnDetail gd On gd.TNo = g.TNo Where g.PurchaseOrderTNo = :P939_TNO And ((Select SAGAR.GetUserPanelAB_apex() From dual) Is Null Or g.Panel = (Select SAGAR.GetUserPanelAB_apex() From dual)) Group By g.GrnNo, g.GrnDate, g.LocationCode Order By g.GrnDate, g.GrnNo
